subject.title: Suppress failed tool progress in Discord

question: Should this Discord message-delivery PR remain blocked on retained after-fix Discord proof, or should maintainers accept the operator-observed canary report plus source-level tests?
rationale: External PR proof is below the normal real-behavior bar, but the code change is focused and the remaining question is whether maintainers want to override that proof gate for this channel-visible suppression.

options.title: Require retained Discord proof
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until a redacted Discord transcript, recording, terminal output, or logs show failed draft progress suppressed and fallback warning delivery preserved.

options.title: Accept source-level confidence
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly override the proof gap and land after resolving the branch conflict, accepting that no retained after-fix Discord artifact exists.

options.title: Pause until proof is practical
options.body: Leave the PR open but paused if neither the contributor nor a maintainer can capture the live Discord path soon.

recommendation.title: Require retained Discord proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR blocked until a redacted Discord transcript, recording, terminal output, or logs show failed draft progress suppressed and fallback warning delivery preserved.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete recently merged adjacent Discord final-preview behavior and is the strongest available routing candidate for a proof-gate override on this message-delivery surface.
